guards.name: guidance_binding
guards.rule: Every selection example must bind one source-kind summary from the private source adapter guidance envelope.

guards.name: first_action_binding
guards.rule: Every selection example must bind the matching private setup first-action result.

guards.name: adapter_chain_binding
guards.rule: Examples must point to the adapter-chain runbook when the current local-file chain applies and mark other source kinds as outside or blocked.

guards.name: non_generating_examples
guards.rule: Selection examples must not execute commands, read private data, create manifests, forecasts, scores, credentials, live fetches, or hosted runtime surfaces.

guards.name: planned_and_unsafe_stop_paths
guards.rule: Planned runtimes, unsupported sources, and unsafe sources must remain stop or replacement guidance before any forecast path.
